corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, status
from pydantic import BaseModel

router = APIRouter(prefix="/selenium/nodes")

class VncStreamResponse(BaseModel):
    node_session_id: str
    vnc_url: str
    expires_in_seconds: int

@router.get("/{node_session_id}/live-stream-url", response_model=VncStreamResponse)
async def get_node_live_stream_url(
    node_session_id: str,
    grid_registry: SeleniumGridRegistry = Depends(get_grid_registry),
    user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    session_info = await grid_registry.get_node_session(node_session_id)
    if not session_info:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="Grid node session not found")

    if session_info.tenant_id != user.tenant_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, detail="Access denied to remote node session")

    vnc_url = grid_registry.generate_novnc_signed_url(node_session_id)
    return VncStreamResponse(
        node_session_id=node_session_id,
        vnc_url=vnc_url,
        expires_in_seconds=300
    )
